# Community & support

[Join our Discord community](https://discord.gg/ynRHp3wRmb) — our preferred place for all questions, bug reports, help, feature requests and discussions about LightSide Hub and every LightSide product.

For troubleshooting or a bug report, include:

- The product and package version.
- Your Unity Editor version and target platform.
- What you expected, what happened and the steps to reproduce it.
- Relevant logs, screenshots or a small reproduction project.

Keep access tokens and other credentials out of public messages and attachments.

[GitHub Issues](https://github.com/LightSideKittens/LightSideEcosystem/issues) are also available for tracking reports.
